title: Jesus old — last charge
english: [[Jesus grew old; he called Israel: I am old >> Bible:Joshua 23:1-2]]. You have seen what the Lord has done. Be strong and keep the law.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Do not mix with remaining nations
english: [[Do not mix with the nations that remain — snares and traps >> Bible:Joshua 23:7-13]]. Do not invoke their gods. Let remaining vices in us not become friends.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Good promises and threatened evils
english: [[Just as the good words were fulfilled, so the Lord will bring evils if you transgress >> Bible:Joshua 23:15]]. Saving fear. Amen.
